basis: Transition from building assurance primitives to proving assurance operates continuously across projects, surfaces, evidence sources, and Owner decisions. The #166-#200 capability build-out is complete (milestone QA-PILOT-ASSURANCE-OPERATING-LAYER-1). The next phase is Assurance Operations Integration — demonstrating the loop works repeatedly in real project operation, not adding more isolated capabilities.

epic_sequence.purpose: Freeze the post-#200 operating baseline. Verify lifecycle chain integrity. Establish operational baseline metrics before introducing new surfaces. Entry gate for the new epic.

Pre-dashboard data reconciliation. Extend pipeline layer registry coverage through slot 200. Regenerate health expected layers. Ensure source-of-truth layer map is complete before dashboard renders assurance state.
Expose assurance state through the main governance dashboard. Inputs: finding lifecycle, risk prioritization, release readiness, evidence freshness. Output: Owner-facing assurance surface.
Validate that multiple projects can independently produce assurance state. Needs: project isolation, finding routing, evidence namespace separation, cross-project overview.
Run the system over sustained project activity. Measure: finding aging, false-positive rate, MONITOR growth, Owner workload, escalation thresholds.
Potential additions: assurance SLAs, historical trend analysis, assurance scorecards, release gates as recommendations only.
